The '''Mark II War Droid''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] model. Several of those droids were used by the [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaugh]] [[Zargnor Clan]] during the [[Great Hunt (c. 3643 BBY)|Great Hunt]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]<ref name="TOR" />
